name: e3-attack-sizing
notes: Aliens size attacks to just beat the defenders' current combat value (FactionGoal_AttackWithFleet.ComputeDesiredFleetCombatValueForAttack, capped near 1.25x on Normal early), so fleets arrive in bite-sized chunks. Measured from the journal: fleet SCV / desired SCV at launch, for alien AttackWithFleet transfers.
expect: vanilla FAILS the concentration assert (median launch ratio ~1.1-1.4); the fixed AI launches decisive, concentrated strikes
asserts: median([r['scv'] / r['desiredScv'] for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet') if r.get('desiredScv')]) >= 2.0

baseline.vanilla-2026-10-11: median launch ratio 1.21 (5 attacks, 2031-32); 1.05 over 13 attacks in the 2034 run
